variants.rule: Frozen MR40 plus nonnegative 30-day momentum on the first eligible raw episode decision.
Baseline admission, then require close > previous close within the first three eligible episode decisions; otherwise reject that episode.
Baseline plus close >= the mean of the previous 200 closed bars on episode admission; no later admission.
Baseline entry; exit at z >= -0.5, and do not reenter until the original episode resets.
Baseline plus a close-only stop at 95% of the actual entry reference open; execute at the next available modeled open, with no guaranteed 5% loss cap and no episode reentry.
Baseline signals; allocate min(1, 0.20 / annualized population volatility of the last 180 closed-bar log returns) at entry only; 365.25*6 annualization, no leverage or resizing.
Exactly the predeclared confirm3 entry and stop5 exit together; no other combinations.
Baseline with 50% of cash allocated at each entry; diagnostic risk control, excluded from variant selection.

execution: Spot long/cash, closed-bar decisions and next-open fills; lot step 0.00001 BTC, minimum quantity 0.00001 BTC, minimum reference notional 1 USDT, quote fees and 8-decimal price/money rounding. Venue limits are current-rule assumptions applied historically. Forced terminal sells are explicit. Independent accounts per window; no monthly resets.
selection: Use 10000-USDT training results only. Score = minimum normal/stress CAGR divided by maximum normal/stress close drawdown. Require positive stress CAGR, stress CAGR >= baseline, worst drawdown <= baseline, and score >= 1.10 times positive baseline score. Pick highest score, tie by listed order; otherwise keep baseline. cash50_control is ineligible.
locked_success_rule: Selected variant must beat baseline normal net PnL, have stress net PnL >= baseline, and reduce normal close drawdown by at least 20% in the locked 2025-onward evaluation. Also report 500-USDT and delayed-fill results without using them for selection.
walk_forward: Six anchored training-only selections: 2024-H1, 2024-H2, 2025-H1, 2025-H2, 2026-H1, 2026-07-01 through 2026-10-20. Report independent fold accounts and geometrically compounded fold returns; fold handoffs explicitly liquidate positions and charge costs. These overlap the fixed evaluation and are not independent samples.

data.long_lbank_history: An attempted bounded public intake failed the existing OHLC integrity validator on its third page. Do not repair, drop, impute or use this history for strategy testing. Retain rejection evidence; use the prior validated Bybit frame for long-history tests and the frozen LBank 30-day frame for transfer diagnostics.

checks: independent ledger cashflow and equity replay
classification: Retrospective model development. Historical baseline data were already studied; chronological holdouts are protected from this run's selection but are not pristine unseen market data. Eight predeclared paths including two controls; no parameter grid, no independent economic qualification.
